question: Will Queens Park Rangers beat Bolton Wanderers on Aug 22, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Queens Park Rangers score more goals than Bolton Wanderers in the official final result of the match.
- "No": Wins if Bolton Wanderers score more goals than Queens Park Rangers in the official final result of the match.
- "Draw": Wins if Queens Park Rangers and Bolton Wanderers finish the match with an equal number of goals in the official final result.

Clarifications:
- The official final result is determined at the end of 90 minutes plus referee-added stoppage time; extra time and penalty shootouts are not included unless the match format officially excludes a draw outcome (e.g. a knockout cup tie where a winner must be determined), in which case the result after extra time and/or penalties is used.
- If the match is postponed, abandoned, or not played before the market's settlement time, settlement is based on the official result if one has been declared.
